handfixes.summary: Hand-wired novel `apps consent` read-only third-party app consent audit: 3 hand-authored files plus a registration graft into the generated root.go.
handfixes.why: The apps-consent consent inventory is a connector-only novel feature authored in place (cli/internal/cli/apps.go, apps_consent.go, and insights/consent.go) and registered by a single hand-added rootCmd.AddCommand line in the generated root.go. A reprint regenerates root.go and drops the registration (and may drop the novel files), silently removing the whole `apps consent` command while the base generated set keeps compiling and passing go test.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Encode the apps-consent novel command in the microsoft-graph press spec (novel-command block) so a reprint regenerates it instead of relying on this graft surviving.
